Gerizim Rehabilitation Trust Provides care for individuals with mental and physical challenges through schools, training institutes, homes, tuition centers, and counseling units Silver Certified 2023 FCRA 12A CSR-1 Transparency Rating: Transparency Rating The transparency rating is calculated based on the amount of information available for the organisation. Geographies Served Programs Humanitarian Programmes State Karnataka States Karnataka The organisation's interventions encompass 4 youth centres focusing on personality development and career guidance, 4 special schools for mentally challenged children with individual attention, 4 children's homes providing physical, educational, and medical care, and 3 vocational training institutes offering work therapy and eco-friendly product production. It also runs 4 free evening tuition centres in remote villages, stressing basic education, health, hygiene, and wisdom teachings. Additionally, 4 help groups promote community development through courses like tailoring and basic computer skills, while 2 social development centres offer counselling and income generation projects. Its village outreach involves helping the needy, reaching the unreached, and guiding the frustrated. Milestones & Track Record Gerizim has grown from its initial 40 children to now operating 4 special schools, 3 vocational training institutes, 4 children's homes, and multiple other support centers across Karnataka. --> --> Leadership Team J Indira Co - Founder Joseph Ponraj Director S Geetabai Treasurer Demographics & Structure Organisation Strength None M&E Internal, External Assessors No --> Political & Religious Declarations On Affiliation if any No On Deployment Bias if any No --> Registration Details PAN Card AAATG0832 Registration Number 321/90-91 CSR Form 1 CSR00018968 VO ID / Darpan ID KA/2018/0217556 --> 12A AAATG0832GE20168 FCRA 094420587 About Headquarters Bangalore, Karnataka Since 1989 Demographies Served Children Specially Abled --> Impact Since 1989, Gerizim has served mentally challenged children, orphans and people in need for over 35 years, providing shelter, education and vocational training to hundreds of beneficiaries. Vision and Mission Gerizim's mission is to 'Serve & Educate' children and women in need who have been forsaken by society, demonstrating God's love through selfless service.
